adaptations: Fade imports point to local snapshots.
Slot cn import points to host CSS-module class-name joiner; PageEnter does not expose asChild.

pageTransitionStack.license: MIT + Commons Clause; unchanged license retained in vendor/animate-ui/LICENSE.md
adaptations: Reuse only the stack effect: full visible-height upward cover, .94 old-page scale, .6 old-page opacity, 500ms, ease.resize.
The upstream React component requires React 19.3; this host remains on 19.2 and uses Document.startViewTransition with the existing React Router.
AppShell sidebar navigation owns the transition; Suspense route commit releases the snapshot. One live React page, no duplicated forms or effects.
Same-page controls, details navigation, tabs, theme transitions and existing overlay exits keep their current owners. Reduced motion and unsupported browsers navigate directly.
Only the edge-lighting idea is retained, adapted to achromatic tokens and close-contact shadows on an existing Card; no extra wrapper.
Dark appearance follows existing html data-appearance rather than upstream global dark class.
Uses existing opaque surface color, no tint, backdrop blur or upstream opacity values; contrast and forced-colors remain host concerns.
No global stylesheet import, fonts, controls, table styles or agent blocks.
solidGlass.status: Reserved only; the order page no longer uses any material wrapper or surface class.
